title: Dungeons & Dragons Collection (Japan, Disc 2): built-in instruction edits
summary: Apply the Shadow over Mystara edits only to the disc that contains their source instructions.
rationale: Both collection discs use product ID T-1245G, but the built-in DND2 callback NOPs the same two RAM addresses on both. Disc 1 has different instructions there. The guarded sector recipe retains the Disc 2 edits while leaving Disc 1 untouched.

writes.effect: Replace the Disc 2 first-read instruction at 060151A6 with a NOP.
writes.reason: Preserve the first upstream DND2 compatibility edit only for its matching disc.

writes.effect: Replace the Disc 2 first-read instruction at 060151AE with a NOP.
writes.reason: Preserve the second upstream DND2 compatibility edit only for its matching disc.
